title: ON.energy
description: Industrial dark with one signal yellow: black pages, #202020 and #323232 panels, off-white text with silver and mid-grey for quieter copy, and a loud #fff313 for big flat fields and small controls. A light neo-grotesk at weight 300 for everything, a grotesk mono for labels, small 6px control corners. Light sibling: the same palette on off-white paper with black ink, the yellow kept.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is our sibling in the same spirit (the original has no light mode)
Hanken Grotesk Variable stands in for Univers Next Pro (closed); DM Mono for ABC Monument Grotesk Mono (closed)
the page gutter follows the window (4.27vw: 17px on phones, 36px at 1440) like the original's outer gutter
on-energy blocks flip some sections with bg-foreground text-background (the light sections) and bg-primary (the yellow ones)
name: on-energy-theme
